♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0 YAFIKA! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, AutoCaptions yokhala ndi **Your script** ndi **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**, ndi **Flex Studio (Beta)** yomwe imayamba kutsitsa kenako imakufunsani isanayike.

*(Ikani pamwamba pa mtundu womwe muli nawo panopa, kenako yambitsaninso After Effects kamodzi.)*

♦️ **Chatsopano: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* Kapangidwe ka **Map desk**, kusaka malo popanda intaneti, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route ndi zina), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, masitayilo a mapu aulere ndi **Open in Flex Maps**.
* Zida zake zowonjezera (kulunzanitsa kwachindunji, masitayilo, zilembo, 3D, Finalize) tsopano zimatsegukadi mkati mwa After Effects.

♦️ **Zatsopano mu AutoCaptions**
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (pa intaneti, imagwiritsa ntchito ma credits a Flex AI) ndiyo injini yovomerezeka, ndipo yasankhidwa kamodzi kwa aliyense. Sankhaninso Whisper kuti mupange mawu ofotokozera kwaulere pa kompyuta yanu (Translate To imafuna Whisper). Seva ikakhala yotanganidwa, imakuwonetsani malo anu pamzere.
* **Your script**: mawu ofotokozera amatenga kalembedwe ndi mawu a script yanu kulikonse komwe munanena mawu amenewo.
* Zotuluka za **Editable template**: mawu ofotokozera ngati ma layer a template omwe mungasinthe kalembedwe kake mu Essential Properties (After Effects 2026).
* Palibe chosankhidwa ndipo Source media ilibe kanthu? Imakupatsani **composition yonse**. Mawu omvera omwewo amagwiritsanso ntchito zolemba zake zakale (transcript).

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** imatsitsa kaye, kenako imafunsa **Install / Not now**.
* Pulogalamuyi (2.0.0-beta.2): malo ogwirira ntchito a **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING**, makiyi a zida ngati a After Effects, makanema amatseguka nthawi yomweyo, ndipo OPEN tsopano imagwira ntchito pa precomps ndi adjustment layers.

♦️ **Zakonzedwa**
* Zowoneka za mutu (theme effects) zomwe zinali zikusowa pa ma PC ambiri a Windows zabwerera (zopepuka ngati makanema ojambula a Windows azimitsidwa).

♦️ **Malo osakakamiza oteteza laisensi**
* Mudzafunsidwa kamodzi kokha, ndipo nzosakakamiza: ngakhale mutasankha **No thanks**, zonse zimapitirizabe kugwira ntchito. Sinthani mu **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Zimasungidwa kwa miyezi 12, sizigulitsidwa konse, ndipo sizigawidwa kwa wina aliyense kupatula pamene lamulo likufuna.

♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0 YAFIKA! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Caption Stack yasamukira mu AutoCaptions** ndi masitayilo a liwu lililonse, makonzedwe, kayendedwe ndi mawu omveka. **UN-NEST** ndi blend modes zimagwira ntchito pa Premiere 26.5, **AUTO CUT** ndi kudina kamodzi kokha, ndipo **Flex Studio (Beta)** imatsegula kanema wanu kuchokera pa panel.

*(Ikani pamwamba pa mtundu womwe muli nawo panopa, kenako yambitsaninso Premiere Pro kamodzi.)*

♦️ **Chatsopano: Mawu ofotokozera osuntha mu AutoCaptions**
* **Kalembedwe ka liwu**: patsani liwu lililonse mitundu yake yeniyeni, font ndi mapeto a Flat, Shine kapena Glow.
* **Makonzedwe a mizere**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside ndi Line.
* **Kayendedwe pa liwu lililonse** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake ndi zina) ndi chiwonetsero choyamba (preview), kuphatikizapo mawu omveka a **Pop / Tick / Swoosh**. Masitayilo a mawu ndi kayendedwe zimafuna zotuluka za **Images**.
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (pa intaneti, imagwiritsa ntchito ma credits a Flex AI) tsopano ndiyo injini yovomerezeka, ndipo yasankhidwa kamodzi kwa aliyense; sankhani injini ya Whisper kuti mupange mawu ofotokozera popanda intaneti kwaulere.
* **Your script** (Captions mode): mawu ofotokozera amatenga mawu a script yanu pamene munanena mawu amenewo.
* Palibe chosankhidwa (khadi la Source lilibe kanthu)? Imakupatsani **timeline yonse**; mawu ofotokozera amasungidwa pafupi ndi pulojekiti yanu.

♦️ **Chatsopano: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Open in Flex Studio** imatsatira kanema mu pulogalamuyo; **APPLY TO PREMIERE** imabweza track. Sinayikidwe? **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** imaitsitsa, kenako imafunsa **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **Zasinthidwa**
* **AUTO CUT** imasanthula kanema wosankhidwa ndikudula ndi kudina kamodzi. **Retakes** imagwira mizere yomwe idayambidwanso.
* **Audio Studio** tsopano ili ndi ma sub-tab asanu ndi limodzi. **Library** tsopano ili mu Nest Saver.

♦️ **Zakonzedwa**
* **UN-NEST** pa Premiere 26.5 (inkakana nest iliyonse), ndi blend modes ngati Screen zomwe zinkabwerera ku Normal (Premiere ya Chingerezi).
* Chizindikiro chofiira cha **AUTOSAVE 0:00**, chiwonetsero chakuda cha Caption Stack, ndi zowoneka za mutu zomwe zinali zikusowa pa ma PC ambiri a Windows.

♦️ **Malo osakakamiza oteteza laisensi**
* Mudzafunsidwa kamodzi kokha, ndipo nzosakakamiza: ngakhale mutasankha **No thanks**, zonse zimapitirizabe kugwira ntchito. Sinthani mu **Flex Settings > Privacy**. Zimasungidwa kwa miyezi 12, sizigulitsidwa konse, ndipo sizigawidwa kwa wina aliyense kupatula pamene lamulo likufuna.
